content:
hello! i made this repo a little while about that wraps the nightly releases, and makes then available thru a nix flake: https://github.com/jaredramirez/roc-nix-nightly. it's auto-updated every night, but you can pin it to get a consistent nightly version

you can already use the roc-lang/roc repo directly as a flake, but it builds from source so it a bit slow and is marked broken for darwin. sharing in case anyone else finds it useful :smile:
I forgot to make an announcement for this but we have roc-lang/roc-overlay :p
I will also add a link to it inside the flake in roc-lang/roc
Jared Ramirez has marked this topic as resolved.
